overview.description: The KraneShares Sustainable Ultra Short Duration Index ETF (KCSH) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund aims to provide a green cash option to investors. The fund is passively managed, seeking to provide current income through ultra-short duration, USD-denominated, investment grade  corporate bonds KCSH was launched on Jul 26, 2024 and is issued by KraneShares.
